## Hot Ones Sauce Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Data on hot sauces used in each season and position of Hot Ones,
including Scoville Heat Unit ratings.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>hotones_sauces
</code></pre>


### Format

A tibble with variables:


<dl>
<dt>season</dt><dd>Season of Hot Ones
</dd>
<dt>order</dt><dd>Sauce position in the lineup (1-10, from mildest to hottest)
</dd>
<dt>sauce_name</dt><dd>Name of the hot sauce
</dd>
<dt>SHU</dt><dd>Scoville Heat Units (SHU) rating
</dd>
</dl>



### Source

Hot Ones / First We Feast (YouTube)
